meta.join_key_province: branches_final.json `prov` folded through regionmap.canonical() (catches ISO-code / English-name / 'จังหวัด ' stragglers) before joining the NSO province layers. All 2,015 branch provinces already resolve to the 77 canonical Thai names; see meta.gaps for provinces absent from a source layer.

occ_top.label: MEASURED
occ_top.source: Overture Maps Places — measured establishment points (a sample/lower bound, not a registry)
occ_top.note: Top-3 catchment occupation buckets by establishment share (count/total, <=10.0 km). A workforce-composition proxy from where businesses are, not a payroll census.

estab_total.label: MEASURED
estab_total.source: Overture Maps Places — measured establishment points (a sample/lower bound, not a registry)
estab_total.note: Total establishments in the branch catchment (Overture sample/lower bound).

factory_workers.label: MEASURED
factory_workers.source: DIW factories_by_district (Department of Industrial Works), via amphoe.json workers
factory_workers.note: Registered factory workers in the branch's DISTRICT (amphoe), only where the district is fac_measured; null otherwise (never fabricated).

informal_pct.label: MEASURED
informal_pct.source: NSO ภาวะการทำงานของประชากร (data.go.th) — workers by province; measured
informal_pct.note: informal / (informal + formal) x100. A province-level MEASURED ratio (province-inherited to every branch in the province); null where the province is absent.

prov_employed_k / prov_labor_force_k / p.label: MEASURED
prov_employed_k / prov_labor_force_k / p.source: NSO Labour Force Survey — provincial summary, via data.go.th / TMLI
prov_employed_k / prov_labor_force_k / p.provenance: MEASURED. Vendored from kaustavb2101/watcher source-data/tmli/nso-lfs-provincial-summary.json. NSO LFS ไตรมาสที่ 3/2568 (table ST_02_2005005_4).
prov_employed_k / prov_labor_force_k / p.unit: *_k fields are thousands of persons (พันคน); unemployment_rate is percent
prov_employed_k / prov_labor_force_k / p.note: Province labour-force health, joined by the branch's province; null where absent.

provinces_absent_from_source: กรุงเทพมหานคร
informal_pct.policy: HONEST NULL — no region-median or any fabricated value is substituted; the field is null for these branches. Any fallback added in future MUST be per-row flagged ESTIMATED.
informal_pct.note: employment_by_province.json covers 76/77 canonical provinces; the absent province(s) — notably กรุงเทพมหานคร (Bangkok) — leave informal_pct null. NSO does not publish Bangkok in the informal/formal workers-by-province table we ingest; a Thai-IP repull may list it under a variant key (กทม.).

province_lfs.policy: HONEST NULL — no region-median or any fabricated value is substituted; the field is null for these branches. Any fallback added in future MUST be per-row flagged ESTIMATED.
province_lfs.note: unemployment_by_province.json covers 77/77 canonical provinces; prov_employed_k / prov_labor_force_k / prov_unemployment_rate are null for any absent province.

meta.provenance: MEASURED assembly. No index or synthetic value is introduced here — this layer only re-projects existing MEASURED source layers (Overture Places, DIW factory workers, NSO employment & Labour Force Survey) onto each branch by index/province. Any field that cannot be sourced for a branch is null.
